t: The Rotor Bearing is the base of your Turbine $(l:bigreactors:turbine/rotor)Rotor$(/l) assembly.$(br2)It must be placed in one of the Turbine faces, usually in the center, and followed by some $(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-rotorshaft)Rotor Shaft$(/l) blocks.
转子轴承是你的涡轮机$(l:bigreactors:turbine/rotor)转子$(/l)组件的底座。$(br2)它必须放置在涡轮机的某个面上，通常位于中央位置，后面还必须接上一些$(l:bigreactors:turbine/part-rotorshaft)转子轴$(/l)方块。
$(l)Mandatory:$() one, and only one, is required$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Variants:$() all$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
$(l)必需：$()需要且只能有一个$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意面上（不在框架上）$(br)$(l)变种：$()全部$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()否
